methods_quotes.q: Weighted response percentages, p-values, and 95% confidence intervals were calculated, overall and by race/ethnicity.
Unadjusted weighted logistic regression was used to test for differences in responses between racial/ethnic groups
differences were considered statistically significant if p-values were ≤0.05
statistical weighting was used during analysis to match the 2019 edition of the Current Population Survey proportions
this study did not adjust for other factors, such as socioeconomic status
